up: Retrieve the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1741324. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, compound name, standard value, standard units, and standard activity type. Only include records where the activity measurement relation is exactly '=' and the standard value is present. Do not apply any additional filters on organism, confidence score, document type, or other attributes. Do not limit the number of returned rows.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, ac.standard_value, ac.standard_units, ac.standard_type FROM assays a JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id JOIN compound_records cr ON ac.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE a.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741324' AND ac.standard_relation = '=' AND ac.standard_value IS NOT NULL
